facts.title: Sansera Engineering share hits fresh 52-week high as Goldman Sachs raises target
facts.takeaway: Goldman Sachs raised its Sansera target to Rs 4,990 with a Buy rating, citing aerospace, defence and semiconductor components and a $180 million semiconductor order.

facts.title: Sansera Engineering shares soared 16%; here's why
facts.takeaway: Q4 FY26 profit more than doubled to ₹123.10 crore from ₹59.20 crore on revenue up 28% to ₹998.70 crore.
